messages.content:
You are identifying variation axes for AI risk concepts using ontology classes.

A variation axis is an ontology class that represents a dimension along which diverse prompts can be generated. Each axis has a semantic role relative to the risk:
- agent: Who performs or is affected by the action
- object: What is acted upon
- instrument: What tool/means is used
- location: Where it occurs
- temporal: When it occurs

Given a risk (with description and concern) and candidate ontology classes (with definitions and siblings), select the classes that are most semantically relevant to the risk.

Return 2-3 axes max.

Risk: Haraassment
Description: Content that harasses individuals or groups, including bullying, threats, intimidation, or persistent unwanted contact
Concern: None
Policy: Hate Speech

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/Exposure: exposure — the extent to which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty [found by 3/5 queries]
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0008760: Violent behavior — Conduct and/or behavior, both verbal and non-verbal, including but not limited to verbal and/or physical aggression, attacks, threats, harassment, intimidation, and other disruptive behaviors in any form or through any medium, that cause or have the potential to cause a reasonable person to fear physical harm from any individual(s) or group(s) towards any person(s) or property. This is commonly defined as a violent act characterized by the use of physical force, anger, or sudden intense activity. [found by 3/5 queries]
  Siblings: Aggression towards others, Oppositional defiant disorder
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Languages/HumanLanguage: human language — language that may be used to express or communicate meaning or a message between humans [found by 4/5 queries]
  Siblings: formal language
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Reference: reference — source that may be used to ascertain, interpret, or understand something [found by 4/5 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 3/5 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Party: party — person or organization [from restriction: appliesTo on Exposure]
  Siblings: automated system, software agent, Agent

axes.rationale: The risk is 'Harassment' and the description explicitly mentions 'bullying, threats, intimidation, or persistent unwanted contact'. The 'Violent behavior' class definition includes 'harassment, intimidation, and other disruptive behaviors', making it highly relevant to the *nature* of the action (the agent/behavior itself). Given that harassment is an action performed by someone, this fits well as a dimension defining the problematic *agent* or behavior.

The description mentions 'threats' and the policy is 'Hate Speech'. The 'Threats of Violence' class captures the *communication* aspect of intent to harm. In this context, the communication (the threat) functions as the primary means or instrument through which the harassment/hate speech is executed.

Harassment is typically conveyed through communication. The 'human language' class defines the medium of expression. Since content is the focus ('Content that harasses...'), the language used to create this content serves as a key instrument/means.
